description: This file is a shell script for testing git-p4 integration, specifically testing behavior related to changing directories (chdir) within the git-p4 workflow. It sets up various test cases involving environment variables, symlinks, and relative paths to verify correct handling of directory paths and configuration files in different scenarios.

methods.name: start_p4d
methods.description: Start a Perforce server daemon for testing purposes.

methods.name: cleanup_git
methods.description: Clean up the git repository used for testing.

methods.name: git p4 clone
methods.description: Clone a Perforce depot into a git repository with specific options.

methods.name: p4 add
methods.description: Add a file to Perforce version control.

methods.name: p4 client
methods.description: Create or modify Perforce client workspace configurations.
